obernants.scope: U=(Reg,key spelling,optional admitted Field/Dom). R composes key with key_ok. U minus R forbids gender admission for O, any E admission, and Stage decoded from status. Downstream payload parsing excluded.
At/Place key output has {at,to,in} antecedents; name status has {Status,Stage}. Successful O admission restricts spellings to name,trait,status,num,at,to,in.
Over nine Reg and thirty Field variants C accepts 30, O 5 and L 4: 39 accepted of 270 pairs. Other registries reject all fields. Explicit literal sets are the proposed oracle.
key(Parent.name()) decodes in to At; key(Target.name()) decodes to to At; Stage.name() decodes status to Status. key(name(f)) cannot be identity on all Field.
gender/age/sleep/freedom/life select Tags; feeling selects TagSet; mother/father Char; num Num; name/goal/belief Text; trait/status Words; at/to/in Place. Routing does not parse payloads.

coverage.description: fields declarations and operation implementations; gaps between selected items allowed
